metadata.title: OFFICE OF THE PUBLIC INFORMATION OFFICER - RTI DISPOSAL REPLY
metadata.legal_basis: Right to Information Act, 2005 & Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023

blocks.text: DISPOSAL OF FIRST APPLICATION UNDER SECTION 7(1) OF RTI ACT, 2005

blocks.title: 1. PARTICULARS OF THE APPLICANT AND APPLICATION

children.text: Applicant Name: Shri Rameshwar Dayal, Mobile: +91 9876543210, Email: rameshwar.dayal84@example.com.
Identity Credentials furnished with application: Resident Aadhaar No. 5489 2104 7832 and PAN No. ABCDE1234F.
Direct Benefit Transfer Account on file: State Bank of India A/C 987654321098, IFSC SBIN0004567.

blocks.title: 2. POINT-WISE INFORMATION FURNISHED BY PUBLIC INFORMATION OFFICER

children.text: Query 1: Provide certified inspection reports and survey maps of Survey No. 89/2A, Haveli Taluka for the years 2023-2025.
Reply to Query 1: The certified copies of Land Survey Cadastral Maps running into 14 folios are enclosed herewith upon realization of statutory fee of INR 28/- under RTI Rules.
Query 2: Furnish personal banking statements, Aadhaar biometric logs, and private contact phone numbers of third-party landowners registered under Survey No. 89/2B.

The information sought under Query 2 constitutes personal information, the disclosure of which has no relationship to any public activity or interest and would cause unwarranted invasion of privacy. Hence, the third-party identifiers (Aadhaar, bank records, personal phone numbers) are exempted from disclosure under Section 8(1)(j) of the RTI Act, 2005 read with Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.

If aggrieved by this decision, an appeal may be preferred under Section 19(1) of the RTI Act within 30 days before the Additional District Magistrate & First Appellate Authority, Collector Office, Pune.
